survivorship-curves-types.alt: Three survivorship curves on a log scale, starting from 1,000 newborns. Type I stays near 1,000 until late in life, then drops steeply (most die old). Type II falls as a straight line on the log scale, so the same fraction die at every age. Type III drops to about 40 by 10% of the life span, then levels off (most die young).
